name: Sample A: Emergency shortage with alternative
description: Exercises the stale EHR instruction, supplied order cases, alternative inventory and repeated events.
policy_text:
Fictional comparison policy A
Effective 2026-11-15, while the fictional shortage flag is active, restrict med-a-iv in dept-emergency and display med-b-oral as its explicitly approved alternative only when oral administration is eligible.

expected_results.Shadow Mode: 1 repeated-event finding for med-a-iv in dept-emergency.
